description: TransferWise (Wise) 'BALANCE CASHBACK' credits on the business account, 21 bank lines grouped by settlement date into 9 vouchers (matches how Wise pays out cashback in date batches). Wise issues no invoice/receipt for these credits, so each voucher is backed by a generated Eigenbeleg PDF (scripts/generate-eigenbeleg.py) listing the individual lines instead of a vendor document. Booked as voucherType 'purchasecreditnote' (expense reduction) against 'Nebenkosten des Geldverkehrs' -- this reduces prior payment/FX fee expense rather than being booked as separate income, per the user's explicit request. 0% VAT: a rebate on a VAT-exempt financial service (Section 4 No. 8 UStG) carries no VAT itself. Vendor entity is inferred as TransferWise Europe SA (Brussels, the Wise entity licensed for EEA customers) -- confirm against the actual account provider shown in your Wise dashboard if this matters.
